description: v12 step 1 gate: five-fold stratified cross-validation on Batch 1 of the four v12 cells with the real network. Folds fixed by the constant src/cv.py uses; each fold fits its projection basis from its own training rows only (normalize.fit receives the rows' Batch 1 positions). No target file is opened. Rule, declared in proposal-v12.md: a projected cell's CV accuracy may not fall more than 0.02 below R-fig-logps.

gate.statistic: final_accuracy at epoch 100 averaged over folds and seeds, and peak accuracy alongside
